title: 第17章 四阶蛇王第18章 你想成为炼丹师吗
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
江尘于是转过身来，打算跟三条三阶大蛇大战一场了。
前方没有路了，下面是五十多米高的悬崖，以他现在的修为跳下去的话，不死也得重伤。
在蛇王谷这么危险的地方，如果重创了，跟找死有什么区别？
“吱吱……”
三条巨蛇死死地盯着江尘，随时打算发动攻击。
三阶妖兽已经有了一定的灵智了，并不是无脑，知道怎么做才是最快地击杀目标的。
“拔刀斩。”
江尘手中的长刀开始蓄力，大量的真气输进长刀之中。
“吱……”
三条巨蛇开始发动攻击，同时出击，向着江尘咬去。
“拔刀斩。”
一道强大的刀气斩出。
直接击中三条扑过来的巨蛇。
“噗，噗，噗。”
三道刀气入肉的声音响起。
三条巨蛇的身上出现巨大的伤口，鲜血直流。
巨蛇更加疯狂了，再次向江尘给咬来。
但是江尘岂是这么好对付的，无踪步快速地躲开巨蛇的攻击。
无踪步真不愧是三阶极品层次的身法武技，脚步无踪，很轻松就躲过了巨蛇的袭击。
如果动用飞浪步的话，想躲过这些攻击可不容易，江尘的内心还是感激唐沐的，她送的身法武技。

三条巨蛇身上有伤，感到十分痛苦，攻击没有那么凌厉了，江尘利用身法的优势，动作如风，手中的长刀斩出，直接击在它们的伤口上，锋利的刀锋，逐一将其斩成两截。
几招过后，三条巨蛇纷纷被斩成两截。
残尸在地上扭动。
断成了两截的蛇，不会马上死去。
看到被重创三条巨蛇，江尘大喜，马上冲上去，给它们补刀，将蛇头给斩下来，这才放松心情。
杀了巨蛇之后，江尘不客气，直接运行功法，将巨蛇残尸体内的血气之力吞噬掉。
江尘的修为提升到武者境七重巅峰，相信再杀一些妖兽，就可以突破到武者境八重了。
随着修为的提升，所需要的灵气越来越多了，三条三阶的巨蛇的血气之力，也没能提升一重的修为。
不过江尘这样的晋级速度已经是相当的逆天了。
这才多长的时间？
就从武徒境一重迈入武者境七重了。
这可是十多个小境界啊。
这样修炼速度可以说是相当的逆天了。
杀了三条巨蛇之后，江尘快速地离开这儿，血腥味可是很容易引来其他的妖兽。
果然，江尘离开没有多久，就有不少的蛇类妖兽来到这儿了，看到面前的巨蛇的尸体，于是开始吞食起来。
江尘在蛇王谷内小心翼翼地前进，奈何蛇类妖兽太多了，经常向他发动袭击，江尘只好将其斩杀，麻烦不断。
不过遇到三阶的蛇类妖兽，江尘还是尽量地躲开的。
先前是他出其不意，才能动用拔刀斩将巨蛇给重创，然后才有机会斩杀对方，否则的话，江尘也会非常被动。
江尘的入侵，也是引起了蛇王谷的很多强大的蛇类妖兽的注意，于是纷纷向江尘所在的方向聚集而来。
但是江尘比较谨慎，不停地躲过这些三阶妖兽区域。

终于，江尘一片区域看到一大簇红色的花。
content_en:
Jiang Chen then turned around and planned to fight with three third-level snakes.
There is no road ahead. Below is a cliff more than fifty meters high. If he jumps with his current cultivation level, he will not die but will be seriously injured.
In a dangerous place like Snake King Valley, if you are seriously injured, what is the difference between seeking death?
"Zhizhi..."
The three giant snakes stared at Jiang Chen, ready to attack at any time.
The third-level monster already has a certain amount of intelligence, and is not brainless. It knows what to do to kill the target as quickly as possible.
"Draw your sword and chop."
The long knife in Jiang Chen's hand began to accumulate strength, and a large amount of true energy was poured into the long knife.
"Squeak..."
The three giant snakes began to attack, attacking at the same time and biting Jiang Chen.
"Draw your sword and chop."
A powerful sword energy slashed out.
Directly hitting three giant snakes that were rushing towards them.
"Pfft, pfft, pfft."
The sound of three sword qi entering the flesh was heard.
There were huge wounds on the bodies of the three giant snakes, and they were bleeding profusely.
The giant snake became even more crazy and bit Jiang Chen again.
But how could Jiang Chen be so easy to deal with? Wu Xingbu quickly dodged the giant snake's attack.
The traceless step is truly a third-level martial arts skill of the highest level. The traceless step makes it easy to avoid the attack of the giant snake.
If he uses the Flying Wave Step, it will not be easy to dodge these attacks. Jiang Chen is still grateful to Tang Mu for the movement and martial arts she gave him.
The three giant snakes were injured and felt very painful. The attacks were not so sharp. Jiang Chen took advantage of his body skills and moved like the wind. He slashed out the long knife in his hand and directly hit their wounds. The sharp blade cut them into two pieces one by one.
After a few moves, the three giant snakes were chopped into two pieces.
The corpse was writhing on the ground.
A snake that is broken into two parts will not die immediately.
Jiang Chen was overjoyed when he saw the three giant snakes that had been severely injured. He immediately rushed forward, cut them off and cut off the snake's heads, and then he relaxed.
After killing the giant snake, Jiang Chen was not polite and directly used his skills to swallow up the power of blood and energy in the remains of the giant snake.
Jiang Chen's cultivation has reached the peak of the seventh level of the warrior realm. He believes that if he kills some monsters, he can break through to the eighth level of the warrior realm.
As the cultivation level increases, more and more spiritual energy is required, and the blood power of three third-level giant snakes cannot improve the cultivation level of the first level.
However, Jiang Chen's promotion speed is already quite incredible.
How long has it been?
He has stepped from the first level of the warrior realm to the seventh level of the warrior realm.
These are more than ten small realms.
This speed of cultivation can be said to be quite incredible.
After killing the three giant snakes, Jiang Chen left here quickly. The smell of blood could easily attract other monsters.
Sure enough, not long after Jiang Chen left, many snake monsters came here. When they saw the corpse of the giant snake in front of them, they began to devour them.
Jiang Chen moved forward cautiously in the Snake King Valley. However, there were too many snake monsters and they often attacked him. Jiang Chen had no choice but to kill them, causing constant trouble.
However, when encountering a third-level snake monster, Jiang Chen still tried his best to avoid it.
Previously, it was his surprise that allowed him to use his sword to severely injure the giant snake, and then he had the chance to kill the opponent. Otherwise, Jiang Chen would have been very passive.
Jiang Chen's invasion also attracted the attention of many powerful snake monsters in the Snake King Valley, so they all gathered in the direction of Jiang Chen.
But Jiang Chen was more cautious and kept avoiding these third-level monster areas.
Finally, Jiang Chen saw a large cluster of red flowers in an area.
